name: COPERNICUS — terraced crater wall

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 312 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: A 93 km young impact crater. The terraced inner wall is the steepest sustained ground in this set.

blurb: A 93 km young impact crater with a terraced inner wall — the steepest sustained ground in this set, and the place where a hop that lands badly has the furthest to go.
